items.title: Edward "Eddie" Richardson Interview, 1960-10-29
items.q: Sometimes Lawrence Dent used to play with you. Well, sometimes he'd get in there.

ctx.x: out. Were they still having any lawn parties?

No, they're not having. I haven't heard of a lawn party in years. No, I think that would be a good drawing feature if they'd start to give them a few lawn parties. In the summertime, that's because that's out in openings. So the wintertime, this kind of, in the winter season come out, lawn parties just out. It's mostly for the summer. You know, somebody else I wanted to ask you about was Tom Anderson's Place. You mentioned that. Yeah. You said you were down by there, huh? Uh-huh. Did you play in any- Oh you mean…
What kind of job do you like best?
